messages:
Drew (Sales): Hey team — quick handoff for Lighthouse (just signed). They need SSO, VPC peering, and a dedicated pool estimate. Renewal conversation in 11 months, but CFO explicitly asked about predictable latency. I’m tagging Aisha to own CS.
Aisha (CS): Thanks Drew — taking this. Quick context: 10k monthly active users expected, bursty queries (search+chat). Sales notes attached: https://redwood.app/customer/lighthouse/summary (internal)
Drew (Sales): Yep — they signed a 12-month commitment but said they'd consider renew/expand early if latency/COST look good. Main blockers: SSO (Okta), private infra, and model choice budget.
Aisha (CS): Owners: Aisha (CS) — onboarding/program, Nina (Solutions) — infra design & estimator, Tom (Support) — post-migration ops. I’ll kick off a 1:1 with customer in 48h.
Nina (Solutions): Thanks — I’ll sketch a Dedicated pool + failover plan. Need expected QPS and avg seq len. Drew, can you paste the perf expectations they gave?
Drew (Sales): From sales call: target p95 < 300ms for chat; willing to pay for reserved capacity; peak QPS ~ 30 sustained, bursts up to ~120 for <5m. Average sequence 120 tokens.
Tom (Support): Noted. I’ll open a runbook template and attach monitoring thresholds. Also: do we want to recommend prefix caching for their search workflows? Could save cost and lower tail latency.
Aisha (CS): Yes please — add caching rec to the runbook. Also flagging renewal risk: CFO wants cost transparency. Nina, include cost delta for quantized vs fp16 and estimated monthly cost for reserved tier vs hosted.
Nina (Solutions): Will do. Initial ask: I’ll create an infra ticket: ENG-6821 (Dedicated planning) with config options and rough TCO. Will also add a template config snippet.
OpsBot: New ticket created: ENG-6821 — "Lighthouse dedicated pool planning" assigned to nina.solutions, due 2024-07-09.
Drew (Sales): Great. Aisha — can you confirm customer enablement timeline? They asked for a pilot within 3 weeks.
Aisha (CS): Pilot timeline seems tight but doable. Week 1: SSO + network setup; Week 2: model selection + test queries; Week 3: canary traffic and metrics. I’ll coordinate internal owners.
Tom (Support): For Week 1 I’ll need access to their Okta metadata and firewall/AP rules. Can someone confirm security point of contact at Lighthouse?
Drew (Sales): POC is Maya Chen (maya@lighthouse.io), security lead. I’ll intro in email after this thread.
Aisha (CS): Action items summary: 1) Drew: intro email to Maya + share perf doc (due today) 2) Nina: ENG-6821 draft + cost options (due 48h) 3) Tom: runbook + monitoring thresholds + caching rec (due 48h) 4) Aisha: schedule kickoff + pilot plan (due 24h).
Nina (Solutions): Added rough quantization estimate to ENG-6821: ~35% cost savings with int8 for chat model; note quality regression risk ~1.5% on our eval set.
Tom (Support): Adding runbook stub: "monitor: p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost per request, cache hit ratio, KV cache hit" — will drop into ENG-6821 and our shared drive.
Aisha (CS): Thanks all. I’ll post a quick update after I email Maya. Can we reconvene here once ENG-6821 is ready? :thumbsup:
Drew (Sales): thanks team — huge followup win if we keep latency tight.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 48h for ENG-6821 status.
